dct_description_sm:
Sign posts and signs from Engineering and Parks departments. Data are not frequently maintained and may have errors, omissions, and duplicates.
  • Sign post survey points are collected when surveyors are in the area if they are required to include them for a project.  This could mean there are sign posts that were collected years ago that no longer exist, or there may be sign posts that have not yet been surveyed and are missing from the dataset. 
  • Parks signs were entered in the field using a tablet so locations are approximate.  Signs are not necessarily on posts; they may be attached to fences, etc.
  • one sign post may have one or more signs affixed to it.
  • There may be duplicates, errors, and omissions due to the way the data have been collected, maintained, and stored separately by engineering and parks departments.
